Appearance

Weatherworn woman in her late forties, sun-tanned skin, voice like rolling surf. Carries herself with the easy confidence of someone who's earned her authority.

What We Know

Mayor of Ardenville. Rose from repairing nets to leading the town. Descended from generations of net-menders. Mediates between the Merchants Guild and Fisherman's Guild to keep the peace.

First Impressions

Pragmatic and direct. Looks you in the eye and speaks plainly — no politician's polish, just practical solutions.
